About 30 m per pixel (38 m on this map),: Ihe dịka mita 30 kwa pikselụ (mita 38 na maapụ a), site na ngafe satịlaịtị otu ụbọchị: akụkụ ụfọdụ nke maapụ tọgbọ chakoo ma ọ bụ nwee igwe ojii, ya mere nwalee ụbọchị ọzọ. Ọ dịchaghị nkọ iji see ụzọ ụgbọ oloko ma ọ bụ nsọtụ okporo ụzọ.
Satellite imagery from NASA's Global Ima: Onyonyo satịlaịtị sitere na Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS) nke NASA dịka maapụ ntọala elu ikuku, maka ụbọchị ị họọrọ: Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 n'ihe dịka mita 30 kwa pikselụ na VIIRS n'ihe dịka mita 250. The whole world each day at about 250 m: Ụwa niile kwa ụbọchị n'ihe dịka mita 250 kwa pikselụ (mita 306 na maapụ a), ya na igwe ojii: maka ọnọdụ mpaghara naanị.
